title: Chapter 937
text:
Seeing that this person was seriously injured and on the verge of death, Aurora stretched out her hand and pressed on his body. Dazzling life energy was released from her fingers. Golden light spots floated, looking like soft gauze, and entered this person's body.

The next moment, the hideous wounds on this person's body quickly healed at a speed visible to the naked eye. The torn flesh closed, the shattered bones stuck together, and the pale face quickly regained its color. Soon, all the wounds were healed. Only the bloodstains on his body proved that he had just been beaten up like a child.

"Oh." This person's eyebrows trembled and gradually woke up from his coma.

"Where am I?" He was confused for a while, but suddenly remembered what happened before he fainted. His face changed drastically, and he stood up abruptly and looked around vigilantly. "Where did that group of lunatics go?"

Fu Ding coughed to attract his attention. "The enemy who attacked you has already run away. We saved you."

"Ran away? This is bad! I finally found their trace, but the trail is broken again. " This person looked distressed. He then looked at Fu Ding and identified them for a while, and suddenly said, "The people I saw before I fainted were you two."

"Yes." Fu Ding pointed at the bloody handprint on his clothes. "You also asked me to stop them."

This person patted his head and said helplessly, "I'm sorry, my injuries were too serious. At that time, my consciousness was already blurred. I didn't want to drag you into danger. If I was awake, I would have asked you to run away."

As soon as he finished speaking, he finally remembered his injuries. He hurriedly checked his body and was shocked by what he saw.

"Hey, where is my wound? Where did that big hole in my chest go?! "

Aurora raised her eyebrows and copied Han Xiao's expression perfectly. "I healed you. This is my ability."

This person hurriedly moved his body and found that not only were his injuries completely healed, his body was also full of vitality as if he had returned to his peak state. His face was full of shock.

It was not that he had never seen a healing ability before, but it was the first time he saw such a powerful healing ability. Looking at the scene around him, at most a few minutes had passed. This healing efficiency was too terrifying.

"I found a treasure!" This person was overjoyed. He hurriedly took a step forward and wanted to grab Aurora's hand. "Are you interested in joining us?"

Fu Ding helplessly stretched his hand out to stop this overly passionate fellow. After a short contact, he realized that this fellow's reaction was a little slow.

"You should at least introduce yourself. This is basic courtesy."

"Oh, of course, of course, of course, I was too excited and forgot." This person embarrassedly, and his face, he said with a solemn. "I am Raymond. I am a member of the Punisher Alliance."

"Of the Punisher.. of the Punisher of the Punisher of the Punisher.

"You guys are not from this Star of the Star?" Seeing that the two of them did not recognize him, Raymond scratched his head awkwardly and explained, "The Punisher Alliance is a Super organization dedicated to protecting the mortals and punishing the evildoers. We are mainly active in this Star System."

With that said, Fu Ding and Aurora immediately understood.

The Punisher Alliance was a civilian Super organization in the Star System. They were the 'superheroes' that a portion of the galactic residents called them.

As the saying went, heroes used their martial prowess to break the law. It was the same in the galactic society. Those who obtained strength would have their thoughts and desires changed. From time to time, wanted criminals would pop up in the various corners of the universe. The main reason was because of the abundance of superpowers, which gave birth to a large number of ambitious villains. At the same time, superheroes were born.

Being a superhero was also a profession. Unlike being a mercenary, this profession was extremely tough. Not only did they have to go around rescuing people, but they might not even be paid for their work.

There were not many people who were willing to invest their superpowers into this profession. Most of them wanted to use their superpowers to exchange for a better life, more wealth, and more power. Thus, there were very few experts who chose to become superheroes. Under normal circumstances, superheroes were formed by a group of like-minded people.

However, there was a benefit to being a superhero. Their reputation far exceeded that of a mercenary.

Although there were not many superheroes, the number of superheroes in the universe was not small. Most of them were active in the local area. Thus, the three Universal Civilizations had established a Superhero Association a long time ago to make it easier to manage. As long as one registered, they would be able to obtain the title of 'Hero' and 'exercise justice' in the designated area without being invited to drink tea.

Apart from the salary, the association would also compensate for any losses caused in the process of 'exercising justice'. Simply put, superheroes were like a bunch of vigilantes in the eyes of the civilizations.

After hearing that, Fu Ding pondered for a moment and did not say his real name.

"I'm Fu Ahem, Chen Xing. She's Aurora."

"Thank you for saving me." Their faces were blurred, and Raymond did not recognize them.

"Tell me, what exactly is going on?" Fordin nodded.

Raymond originally did not want to drag outsiders into this, but Aurora's ability changed his mind. He explained everything in detail.

"The people who attacked me earlier belong to a cult of zealots. They believe in a certain evil god and call themselves the Blood Hammer Cult. They use blood sacrifices to carry out rituals and have committed many crimes in this star system. They are old rivals of our Punisher Alliance."

Hearing this, Fudin frowned. He didn't like this barbaric act of using ordinary people as blood sacrifices.

The three Universal Civilizations' territories had good law and order, but it was impossible to prevent all crimes. Occasionally, there would be some criminals that escaped the net.

Unless it was a wanted criminal with extremely high combat strength or a very serious case, the Universal Civilizations would not always do the job themselves. Usually, the local vassal civilizations or mercenaries would deal with the wanted criminals to save on security resources. If the vassal civilizations could not handle the case, the Universal Civilizations would intervene.

The Blood Hammer Church did not use many ordinary people as blood sacrifices, and many of their operations were stopped by the Punisher Alliance. At the same time, they would not go to the dynasty's colonial planets to capture ordinary people as blood sacrifices. Thus, the destruction caused by their actions did not reach the point where the dynasty had to deal with them personally.

"I coincidentally discovered traces of those lunatics in Enya Hub and was worried that they would conduct a blood sacrifice here. Thus, I secretly followed them and wanted to find out where they were. It was a pity that I was discovered midway. You guys know what happened next. If not for you guys, I would already be dead." Raymond smiled bitterly.

"I see." Fu Ding sighed. "What's your plan now?"

"Don't worry, I have already informed my other companions. They are rushing over to Enya Hub. Before that, I will continue to track down the traces of the Blood Hammer Church. I cannot allow them to harm ordinary people here." Raymond grinned. "However, I am not their match alone."

"You can look for Enya's army and police force." Aurora remained unmoved.

"I will make a report, but I am only an ordinary superhero. They will not allow me to join their work. Furthermore, I cannot just sit around and do nothing. Thus, I have to do something myself," Raymond said. "I hope that the two of you can help me. I sincerely invite the two of you to join the Punisher Alliance."

Fu Ding did not deny it. Many superheroes had the same problem of being lone rangers, and Raymond was obviously interested in Aurora's Esper Ability.

"How about this? Let us consider it."

After pondering for a while, Feidin did not make a definite decision. He decided to report it and listen to Han Xiao's opinion.

It was not that he wanted to be a busybody, but this was the dynasty's territory, and they were the dynasty's allies. It would not be good for them to ignore a group of fugitives who seemed to want to cause trouble. After all, their identities were still here, and they would try their best to stop them if they could. To the Black Star Army, this was just a small matter.

"Punisher Alliance? Blood Hammer Church? "

In the training room, Han Xiao opened his eyes and looked at the projections of Fu Ding and Aurora with a weird expression.

He was originally training his energy, and he had just received a call from Fu Ding and Aurora.

Han Xiao searched for information in his previous life and had some impression of these two organizations.

The Punisher Alliance was a minor faction, and it did not affect one's identity after joining it. In his previous life, there were some players who joined the Punisher Alliance to enjoy themselves as superheroes. During that period, the Blood Hammer Church had already disappeared, and the players came into contact with the storyline of the Blood Hammer Church through the dungeon crystals that were dropped by the faction.

In his previous life, when he was training his smurf account, he had played the Blood Hammer Church dungeon many times. The priests in the dungeon used the [Evil God Blood Sacrifice] as a means of healing. Their battle hammers were swinging vigorously, and they were able to attack, tank, and heal at the same time. This left a deep impression on him.

In front of the Blood Hammer Church, the priests who only knew how to heal were all little brothers. The correct style of a priest should be to destroy the mortal world with a war hammer!

In his previous life, the Punisher Alliance had a side storyline where they defeated many villains and collected many spoils of war. One of the spoils was a relic left behind by a powerful Super, and a powerful secondary dimensional life form was sealed within it.

Many years later, this life form broke the seal and caused the Punisher Alliance to suffer heavy casualties.

Han Xiao clearly remembered that it was because the mission reward for killing the Unique Boss of this sealed creature was two talents. One was to increase his mental resistance, and the other was to increase his magic resistance. Both were quite significant.

The relic itself was also very valuable as it could greatly increase a Psychic's ability.

Looking at Fu Ding's clueless expression, Han Xiao had a complicated expression.

Are you able to pick up money every time you go out?

— —

(I had to rush to catch a flight today. I woke up in the morning and only arrived in the afternoon. I had a child sitting next to me, and it was so noisy that I couldn't sleep. In the middle of the flight, I even got carsick. I was really tired. Originally, I was supposed to add another plot to increase the progress, but my eyes were so blurry that I couldn't even open them. I was really too tired to write, so I had to write less today. Brothers, please forgive me.)

PS: I actually didn't get last place in the breaking update event. I heard that I was in fourth place. I was shocked. The elderly team really has the characteristics of an elderly person ((OД))/"
